title: Apply for a replacement driving instructor licence
summary: You can apply for a replacement driving instructor licence online or at a Service NSW centre.
intro:
You can apply for a replacement driving instructor licence if:

A non-refundable fee is payable unless you're replacing your licence because:

You can submit your replacement application online or at a Service NSW centre.
who_can_apply: Hold a current NSW driving instructor licence.
Hold a current full (unrestricted) driver licence.
If your name has changed, the licence must be in your new name.
what_you_need: Your current driver licence (with your new name if applicable).
Supporting documentation for your name change (if applicable).
A secondary proof of identity document (if you hold an interstate driver licence).
A digital photo of yourself (if you've changed your appearance).
Two passport size photos (if applying at a service centre).

how_to_steps.text: Select the 'Apply online' button.Note: You cannot save and resume your replacement application once you've started.
Follow the prompts to submit your application.
Download and complete a Replacement Application – PDF and a Change of Records – PDF.Note: Do not sign the forms – your signature must be witnessed at the service centre.
Visit a service centre and lodge your applications.

more_info.text: You'll need to return your original driving instructor licence to TfNSW, unless the card has been lost or stolen. The instructions for this will be in the letter accompanying your new driving instructor licence.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for a replacement driving instructor licence?
faqs.a: You must hold a current NSW driving instructor licence and a current full (unrestricted) driver licence.

faqs.q: What do I need if I have changed my name?
faqs.a: The licence must be in your new name. You will need supporting documentation for your name change.

faqs.q: How can I apply for a replacement licence?
faqs.a: You can apply online or visit a Service NSW centre. If applying at a service centre, you must also bring two passport size photos.
